data.change_summary: Fixed gas-exchange scaling so total O2/CO2 surface flux depends on exposed surface area rather than water volume. Added REFERENCE_SA_V_CM2_PER_L constant (1000.0/19.0 ≈ 52.63 cm²/L) to dissolved_oxygen.rs, calibrated to the default tank geometry (40×25 cm footprint, ~19 L net water). Modified compute_o2_kla() to normalise the hardware-derived raw K_LA by (actual_SA_V / reference_SA_V), so two tanks with the same footprint but different fill heights exchange the same total mass per hour at the air–water interface. Since compute_co2_kla() delegates to compute_o2_kla(), the fix applies to both O2 and CO2 paths. Rewrote test_co2_exchange_independent_of_tank_volume to assert physically correct invariants: (1) equal surface flux (total DIC mass change within 10% for same-footprint tanks), and (2) faster concentration change in the shallower tank (shallow > deep × 1.1). For the default geometry the SA/V ratio equals the reference, so the normalisation multiplier is 1.0 and all existing default-geometry tests are unaffected.
outstanding_risks: The SA/V normalisation assumes process parameters (reaeration_kla_base, aeration_kla_boost) were calibrated for the default geometry. If custom geometries with extreme SA/V ratios are used (e.g., very tall narrow tanks), the linear scaling may overestimate K_LA — but this is physically correct behavior and the Euler cap at 1.0 remains as a safety guard.
Pre-existing test failure trim_plants_is_closed_system_via_helpers in budget_helpers.rs remains unrelated to gas exchange and outside this task's scope.

steps.description: Read dissolved_oxygen.rs and geometry.rs to understand the existing K_LA computation and available SA/V helpers
Added REFERENCE_SA_V_CM2_PER_L constant (1000.0/19.0) to dissolved_oxygen.rs with documentation explaining the calibration basis
Modified compute_o2_kla() to compute sa_v = surface_area_cm2() / volume_l and return raw_kla * (sa_v / REFERENCE_SA_V_CM2_PER_L) instead of bare raw_kla, making surface flux area-proportional

Rewrote test_co2_exchange_independent_of_tank_volume in co2_exchange.rs to assert equal surface flux (total DIC mass change < 10% relative diff) and faster concentration change in the shallower tank (shallow > deep × 1.1)
